title: Purpose and architecture
content:
Local document test
  Generated DOCX -> Word -> loopback receiver
  -> SQLite event -> classification -> console alert

Separate cloud test
  Controlled HTTPS request -> Azure receiver
  -> Table Storage event -> notification outcome
  -> DCR -> CanaryHit_CL -> scheduled rule -> Sentinel incident
meaning: Extended the local document-token receiver with Azure Table Storage and Sentinel ingestion. Word and cloud callbacks were exercised separately.

title: Starting state and baseline
meaning: Recorded the local SQLite starting point and nine passing baseline tests before adding the Azure adapters.

title: Infrastructure deployment
meaning: Deployed the Bicep resources successfully. Resource identifiers and endpoint values are omitted from the saved response.

Management routes return 404 in receiver-only mode.
meaning: Summarized the security settings implemented in the deployment template: shared keys and registry admin access disabled, HTTPS required, and management routes disabled in receiver-only mode.

meaning: Requested the deployed health endpoint; it returned HTTP 200 with receiver-only mode and Azure Table Storage.

title: Sentinel analytic rule
content:
{
  "displayName": "Canary document access detected",
  "enabled": true,
  "severity": "High",
  "queryFrequency": "PT5M",
  "queryPeriod": "PT10M",
  "triggerOperator": "GreaterThan",
  "triggerThreshold": 0,
  "query": "CanaryHit_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | where EventType == \"canary_trigger\"",
  "incidentConfiguration": {
    "createIncident": true,
    "groupingConfiguration": {
      "enabled": false,
      "groupByAlertDetails": null,
      "groupByCustomDetails": null,
      "groupByEntities": null,
      "lookbackDuration": "PT5M",
      "matchingMethod": "AllEntities",
      "reopenClosedIncident": false
    }
  }
}
meaning: Deployed a five-minute Sentinel rule with a ten-minute lookback and incident creation enabled. The query selected all callback rows; scanner and repeat rows were included.
